@@U00505@@
And even if he hadn’t come to terms with the devil,
he'd still know defeat in the end.

@@U00507@@
(Entering.)

@@U00508@@
Excuse me, sir, I’m new here,
just barely arrived—and, well,
longed to make the acquaintance of a man
the world respects and honors.

@@U00510@@
Your courtesy flatters me.
Thank you. And yet,
I’m a man like many another.
Have you called on any of my colleagues?

@@U00512@@
Please, sir, take me under your wing.
I come with the best of intentions,
a fair amount of money, and a healthy body.
My mother—
well, she almost didn’t let me leave—
but I’m eager to learn, it’s why I’m here.

@@U00514@@
Then I'd say you've come to the right place.

@@U00516@@
To be honest, sir, I wish I could escape right now.
It’s so cramped. These walls, these halls,
they intimidate me. It’s so bleak—no green,
no trees, no grass. And the lecture halls,
the benches!
I can’t hear or see or think!

@@U00518@@
Yes, well, that comes with practice.
The child at first is hesitant at the mother’s breast,
but soon it feeds with gusto; and so with you.
You'll find as you suck daily at Wisdom’s breasts,
translation:
@@U00505@@
即使他没有与魔鬼妥协，
他最终还是会失败。

@@U00507@@
（进入。）

@@U00508@@
对不起，先生，我是新来的，
刚刚到达——而且，好吧，
渴望结识一个男人
受到世界的尊重和荣耀。

@@U00510@@
你的礼貌使我受宠若惊。
谢谢。然而，
我和其他许多人一样。
你拜访过我的同事吗？

@@U00512@@
先生，请将我置于您的羽翼之下。
我怀着最美好的愿望而来
有足够的钱，还有健康的身体。
我的母亲——
好吧，她差点就不让我离开——
但我渴望学习，这就是我来这里的原因。

@@U00514@@
那么我想说你来对地方了。

@@U00516@@
说实话，先生，我希望我现在就能逃脱。
太拥挤了。这些墙壁，这些大厅，
他们恐吓我。真是荒凉——没有绿色，
没有树，没有草。还有演讲厅，
长凳！
我听不到、看不到、也无法思考！

@@U00518@@
是的，嗯，这需要练习。
孩子一开始在母亲怀里犹豫不决，
但很快它就津津有味地吃了起来；你也是如此。
当你每天吮吸智慧的乳房时，你会发现，
